preprocessing: EXIF transpose; RGB; LANCZOS contain; centered white padding; PNG compress_level=6
instructions: Does the image in state field query show at least one visible industrial anomaly (surface damage, contamination, missing material or component, or structural irregularity)? Treat normal_references, if provided, as normal examples of the same object category. Judge query, not the references. Ordinary differences in viewpoint, lighting, background, or object identity alone are not defects.

criteria.true: At least one visible industrial defect is present in query.
criteria.false: No visible industrial defect is present in query.
